VALUE:
Tap a place. A card slides up from the bottom. Drag the little bar at the top of the card up for a bigger view, or down to dismiss.

Filter by category. Use the pills at the top. Tap to hide or show a category; tap "Reset" to bring them all back.

Compare old and new. When an old map is on, drag the ⇆ handle left and right to wipe between then and now.

Share a place. Open a place and tap "Share this place" — the link will take your friend straight there.

Save for offline use. Open your passport (🏆 in the top-right) and tap "Save this map for offline use." After it finishes, the map, photos, and stories work without a signal. Great for walking tours.
